notes: Access: curl_cffi Chrome124 impersonation (per notes/220.md); direct requests would 403. robots.txt explicitly ALLOWs ClaudeBot/Claude-Web/Claude-User/Claude-SearchBot/anthropic-ai (no disallow) - no access-tier escalation needed, tier-1 HTTP fetch sufficient throughout. Content confirmed English only (title/H1/meta all English; no Hindi text seen). Marketplace scrutiny: Pepperfry is a multi-seller marketplace (like Amazon/Etsy) but presents one unified site-level catalog/URL structure, not per-seller storefronts - the page found below is Pepperfry's own site-curated merchandising page (confirmed via <title>, <h1>, meta description all independently naming 'Best Sellers' as the page's own concept), not a per-listing 'Bestseller' badge on an individual PDP. Checked: (1) main nav / header mega-menu - top-level verticals only (Furniture, Home Decor, Lamps & Lighting, Kitchen & Dining, Furnishings, Sofas & Seating, Mattresses, Luxury, Modular) with no Bestsellers/Popular/Trending nav item; (2) footer - 'Popular Categories' section lists only product categories (Sofas, Beds, etc.), not a Bestsellers PLP; (3) sitemap-index.xml (11 vertical sitemaps: furniture/home_decor/lamps_and_lighting/mattresses/kitchen_and_dining/furnishings/sofas_and_seating/luxury/products/stores/blogs, plus generic website.xml) - no dedicated bestsellers sitemap or URL entry; (4) direct URL probing across /best-sellers.html, /bestsellers.html, /category/best-sellers*.html, /category/top-sellers.html, /category/popular.html, /discover/bestsellers.html, /discover/top-sellers.html, /discover/most-popular.html, /discover/trending-products.html, /discover/best-selling.html, /discover/bestselling-products.html etc. - all 404 except /discover/best-sellers.html (200, valid); (5) banner-tile cross-check on furniture.html, home-decor.html, lamps-and-lighting.html, kitchen-and-dining.html, sofas-and-seating.html, mattresses.html, luxury-brand.html, furnishings.html, and sub-category pages dining-tables.html/beds.html - none link a best-sellers tile (the found URL is live but not currently linked from any nav/banner I could reach; it was found by systematic URL-pattern probing matching the sibling live /discover/clearance-sale.html naming convention, then independently validated by content). Page validated as a genuine PLP: real product grid with sofa listings (Bingo Leatherette/Fabric/Velvet Sectional Sofa variants) rendered server-side via item-list-structured-data JSON-LD, not editorial/marketing copy. Only one undifferentiated Bestsellers listing was found; no genuine site-exposed sub-structure (e.g. per-vertical Bestsellers) was found, so no grouping row was created.
